name: node-ws-api
title: Node WebSocket API
blurb: WebSocket service on bare Node: ws upgrade on one path, presence broadcast, live two-client contract test, SIGTERM drain

verify.name: http
verify.cmd: if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5453/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'port 5453 is already answering - stop that process before running this step'; exit 1; fi; PORT=5453 node src/main.js >.node-ws.log 2>&1 & srv=$!; ok=1; for _ in $(seq 1 120); do if curl --max-time 2 -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5453/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=0; break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; kill -0 $srv 2>/dev/null || { echo 'the server exited before it answered'; cat .node-ws.log; exit 1; }; if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then cat .node-ws.log; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; exit 1; fi; health=$(curl --max-time 10 -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5453/health); gone=$(curl --max-time 10 -s http://127.0.0.1:5453/nope); wrong=$(curl --max-time 10 -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:5453/health); PORT=5453 node tools/contract.mjs; rc=$?; kill $srv 2>/dev/null; wait $srv 2>/dev/null; test $rc -eq 0 && test "$health" = '{"status":"ok","clients":0}' && test "$gone" = '{"error":"not_found","detail":"no route for GET /nope"}' && test "$wrong" = 405
